claims.summary: The v0.15.51 Project Management finish state showed too much raw warning copy in the export card and agent panel.
Downloadable packages with non-blocking caveats now use calm Ready with notes copy and keep details behind review-note toggles.
Amber review truth and report evidence remain intact; clean green readiness is still reserved for packages without quality, texture, source, or export caveats.
Slide speaker notes shorten repeated long assessment artifact names without creating a new texture or readiness warning.
